closeAll.title: Cut every live connection?
closeAll.description_one: {{count}} live connection will be cut. Devices reconnect on their own, but downloads and calls in progress will break.
closeAll.description_other: {{count}} live connections will be cut. Devices reconnect on their own, but downloads and calls in progress will break.

closedNote: Closed connections are collected by the panel: sing-box reports only live ones, so a connection that disappears between updates would otherwise vanish without a trace. The history lives while the tab is open.

empty.title: No connections
empty.description: The stream is running: rows appear as soon as traffic goes through sing-box.
